title: An Arithmetical Function Related to Báez-Duarte’s Criterion for the Riemann Hypothesis
venue: Harmonic Analysis and Applications, Springer Optimization and Its Applications 168, 43–58
publication_status: Published book chapter counterpart verified. Mathematical reading used the preprint.
version_note: The source hash and proposition locators refer to arXiv v1, not the Springer chapter. The DOI and chapter metadata were checked, while a full text comparison was outside scope.
audit_scope: Targeted §1 definitions, §§2–3 coefficient and Mellin passages, §4 Propositions 10–11 and proof of (11), §5 Propositions 12–13, and §6 Question 2. No full read or chapter-version comparison.
scoped_statement: D₀ is the integer-cell step space and the closed natural Beurling span is all of D₀ under RH. For an element of that span the successive-jump Dirichlet series divided by ζ is holomorphic on Re s>1/2, by passage of every vanishing zero jet below its multiplicity to the norm limit. Möbius inversion gives continuous fixed coefficient functionals.
selection_reason: Exact primary antecedent to the discrete all-multiplicity obstruction and projection-coordinate method. Substituting the logarithmic jump target and obtaining the η′ quotient is the separate archive deduction.

audit_scope: Targeted Theorem 1.1 (2), Theorem 1.2 (7), §1.1 balanced floor formulation, and the §3 Landau link around Theorem 3.1. The classification proof and hypergeometric analysis were outside scope.
scoped_statement: At a=b=1, (2) is the parity seed floor(x)−2 floor(x/2) and (7) is the central binomial coefficient. §1.1 identifies the balanced floor class used in the integer Nyman–Beurling problem.
selection_reason: Exact parity seed and central factorial family occurring in the explicit k=2 target. The source statements concern the seed and integer factorial ratios.

title: A divergent Vasyunin correction
publication_status: ArXiv preprint verified. A separate journal manifestation was not verified.
version_note: PDF manuscript dated 12 June 2005. Section 2's statement and the abstract concern the weighted half-line space; the floor functions vanish on (0,1).
audit_scope: Targeted abstract, §1 context and §2 equations (2.1)–(2.3), with the statement of Theorem 2.1. Remaining arguments outside scope.
scoped_statement: Vasyunin’s first correction uses the parity seed floor(x/d)−2 floor(x/(2d)) and chooses coefficients recursively to approach the constant pointwise. Theorem 2.1 proves divergence in the weighted L¹ norm.
selection_reason: Exact primary antecedent for the parity seed under integer dilation and the need for norm control beyond prefix agreement. Its divergence theorem concerns the original constant-target correction.
